annotations.title: utilpeek: inspect a text for hidden or look-alike Unicode

description: utilpeek: Find invisible, bidi and homoglyph Unicode characters in text. For injected instructions use check_text_for_prompt_injection. Returns a security-oriented Unicode inspection: `risk` (low / medium / high) with reasons; invisible characters (zero-width, tag characters that can smuggle prompt-injection text, controls) with positions; bidi controls (Trojan Source, CVE-2021-42574); UTS #39 confusables and mixed-script words (`pаypal` with a Cyrillic а); combining-mark floods; scripts and normalization status; optionally the text normalized or with invisible characters stripped. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/detect-ascii-smuggling-invisible-unicode-api.html

list_chars.description: List the first N code points with name / category.
list_chars.title: List Chars

normalize.description: Also return the text in this normalization form: NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD (default none).
normalize.title: Normalize

skeleton.description: UTS #39 confusable skeleton of the whole text.
skeleton.title: Skeleton

strip_invisible.description: Return the text without bidi / zero-width / tag / control characters.
strip_invisible.title: Strip Invisible
